run_OeTeacher: run the VQA v2.0 Open-Ended teacher to load questions and annotations from JSON data files
create_OeTeacher_get: create a teacher action dict with question text, image ID, and answer labels for an episode
run_OeTeacher_next_example: run the next example method to queue up the next VQA example with background image loading
run_AllTeacher_act: run the AllTeacher act method to get VQA actions with multiple choice answer labels included
review_OeTeacher_setup_data: review the OeTeacher _setup_data method that loads VQA questions and annotations from JSON files
